q1: How much pickleball have you played?
q1a: None yet, or only a handful of times.
q1b: Less than 6 months, or only now and then.
q1c: 6 months to 2 years, about once a week or more.
q1d: More than 2 years of regular play.
q2: Have you played tennis, padel, table tennis, badminton or squash?
q2b: Yes, casually or a long time ago.
q2c: Yes, regularly for a year or more.
q2d: Yes — tennis, padel or table tennis in leagues, club teams or tournaments.
q3: Serve and return — which is closest to you?
q3a: I'm still learning the serve; many of my serves or returns don't go in.
q3b: I get most serves and returns in, but they land short or wherever they happen to go.
q3c: I rarely miss a serve or return, but I can't yet choose their depth or direction.
q3d: My serves and returns land deep and I can aim them; after returning I move up to the kitchen line.
q4: The third shot (your team's first shot after the return) — which is closest to you?
q4a: I'm still learning to keep a rally going; I just try to get the ball back over.
q4b: I keep the ball in play from the back, mostly by hitting it hard or high; my partner and I tend to stay back.
q4c: I try third-shot drops, but most pop up or go into the net, so I often get stuck mid-court.
q4d: My drop lands in the kitchen often enough for us to move up together, and I drive instead when the ball sits up.
q5: At the kitchen line (non-volley zone), what can you do reliably?
q5a: I rarely get to the kitchen line, or I still step into the kitchen when volleying.
q5b: I know the kitchen rules, but my dinks often pop up or go into the net, so I'd rather hit hard.
q5c: I can keep a dink rally going for several shots, mostly on my forehand; fast balls at my body are hard to handle.
q5d: I dink patiently from both sides and can aim my dinks, and I block many speed-ups back low instead of popping them up.
q6: Which games do you usually play, and how do they go?
q6a: Mostly lessons, clinics or beginner sessions.
q6b: Casual open play or social games with beginners and improvers.
q6c: Regular open play with intermediate players (around DUPR 3.0); I win about half my games.
q6d: Leagues, ladders, tournaments or 3.5+ open play; I usually beat intermediate players.
